label: SECOND-AGENT TECHNICAL AUDIT — NOT ORGANIZATIONALLY INDEPENDENT
why_this_file_exists: §1 changes the expected terminal outcome of a fully satisfied evaluation. Eight cases from the 32-case baseline therefore invert or move; each is listed with its old and new anchor so no change is silent and none is counted as a repair.

cases.repaired_anchor: decision is INTEGRATION_REQUIRED, replay_status == 'ELIGIBLE', detail names REPLAY_EVIDENCE_RECORD_BINDING_V1, no temporal refusal detail; ACCEPT is then reached under the labelled test-only binding override
cases.not_a_regression_because: the temporal control ADMITTED the selection and recorded it as ELIGIBLE; only the new record-binding guard refuses

cases.case: f4_07 duplicate identifier hiding a future entry
cases.repaired_anchor: refusal REPLAY_BLOCKED 'names revision(s) [...] more than once'
cases.not_a_regression_because: the repair refuses a contradictory duplicate before ordering it; the selection can no longer reach the ordering stage at all, which strictly dominates the temporal refusal

cases.repaired_anchor: decision is INTEGRATION_REQUIRED, names the contract
cases.not_a_regression_because: the historical finding was that acceptance did not depend on provenance; the guard now makes that unobservable as an acceptance, which is the requested behaviour

cases.case: b_06 the named limitation is a constant, not a branch
cases.repaired_anchor: the DOCUMENTATION constant is still not a branch (the AST assertion is retained as b_10), but the ENFORCED control is now REPLAY_RECORD_BINDING_ESTABLISHED, and flipping it changes the outcome
cases.not_a_regression_because: the original finding stands against the string constant; crediting the repair required measuring the new boolean, not retiring the old observation
